CITY OF LA VERNE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  HELD VIA TELECONFERENCE
  Wednesday, August 11, 2021

1.  Chairperson Simison called the regular meeting of the La Verne Planning
  Commission to order at 6:30 p.m. He stated that all comments should be sent to
  planning@cityoflaverne.org.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Chairperson Simison led the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL: Planning Commissioners present: Jeff Allred, Thomas Allison,
  Jason Lorge and Jason Simison. Advisory personnel present: Community
  Development Director Eric Scherer, City Attorney Bob Kress, Contract Planner
  Vanessa Norwood and Secretary Natalie Hiatt.

4.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS

  Commissioner Allred nominated Commissioner Simison as Chairperson. Election
  of Chairperson Simison approved by a 4-0 vote.

  Chairperson Simison nominated Commissioner Allred as Vice-Chairperson.
  Election of Vice-Chairperson Allred approved by a 4-0 vote.

5.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  No public comments were received.

6.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES - July 14, 2021

  It was moved by Commissioner Allred and seconded by Commissioner Lorge to
  approve the minutes. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

PUBLIC HEARINGS

7.  CASE NOS. 102-18PPR; 60-19TR; 59-19ANX; 104-18GPA; 103-18ZC; 101-
  18TTM – ANNEXATION OF AN APPROXIMATE 19.44 ACRE PARCEL
  FROM THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES TO THE CITY OF LA
  VERNE; A GENERAL PLAN AMMENDMENT AND PRE-ANNEXATION
  ZONE CHANGE TO ESTABLISH LAND USE AND ZONING
 Planning Commission Minutes
August 11, 2021
  DESIGNATIONS FOR THE SITE; SUBDIVISION OF THE PARCEL
  INTO NINE LOTS FOR THE FUTURE DEVELOPMENT OF SEVEN
  SINGLE-FAMILY DWELLING UNITS AND TWO OPEN SPACE LOTS
  LOCATED AT 500 BASELINE ROAD (8666-006-035) CURRENTLY
  WITHIN UNINCORPORATED LOS ANGELES COUNTY.

  RESOLUTION NO. 1277

  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, STATE OF CALIFORNIA,
  RECOMMENDING APPROVAL TO THE CITY COUNCIL OF CASE NO.
  59-19ANX – ANNEXATION OF 19.44 ACRES INTO THE CITY OF LA
  VERNE, 104-18GPA – A GENERAL PLAN AMMENDMENT UTILIZING
  THE LOW DENSITY RESIDENTIAL LAND USE DESIGNATION, 101-
  18TTM – VESTING TENTATIVE TRACT MAP 082001 TO CREATE
  NINE INDIVIDUAL LOTS, 104-18ZC – A PRE-ANNEXATION ZONE
  CHANGE FROM COUNTY DESIGNATION OF A-1-15000 TO PR3D,
  (PLANNED RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT – 3 UNITS/ACRE) HDOZ
  (HILLSIDE DEVELOPMENT OVERLAY ZONE), REQUESTS BY
  RAMZY FAKHOURY FOR PROPERTY LOCATED AT 500 BASELINE
  ROAD (8666-006-035) AND RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF THR
  PREPARED MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION FOR THE
  PROJECT.

  Mr. Scherer stated that one public comment was received via email.

  Planner Vanessa Norwood presented her staff report.

  Chairperson Simison opened the public hearing.

  Mr. Scherer introduced the representative Steve Hunter of Design Land
  Consultants. Mr. Hunter proceeded with a presentation.

  There were no other requests to speak on this item.

  Chairperson Simison closed the public hearing.

  The Commissioners proceeded to ask questions regarding the elevations, the
  environmental impact, and the community workshops.

  Environmental Consultant Curtis Zacuto was present to discuss the environmental
  reports.

  Chairperson Simison re-opened the public hearing per a request to speak by
  phone.

  2
 Planning Commission Minutes
August 11, 2021
  Bill Henley neighbor of the proposed project spoke in support of the
  development. Mr. Henley made suggestions regarding a crosswalk and center
  median.

  Chairperson Simison closed the public hearing.

  Mr. Scherer addressed Mr. Henley’s concerns for a median.

  It was moved by Commissioner Allison and seconded by Commissioner Allred to
  recommend City Council approval of Case Nos. 59-19ANX; 104-18GPA; 103-
  18ZC; and 101-18TTM. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

OTHER MATTERS/INFORMATION

8.  CASE NOS. 120-19CUP AND 121-19CUP, AND 122-19PPR – 2244
  FOOTHILL BOULEVARD - EXTENSION REQUEST FOR CHUZE
  FITNESS PROPOSED PRIVATE FITNESS GYM WITH EARLY
  MORNING OPERATIONS AND EXTERIOR MODIFICATIONS.

  Mr. Scherer stated that the Conditional Use Permits approval expired in March
  2021 and an extension would be valid through March 2022.

  Applicant Kevin Kohan of Enlighten Entitlements was present at the meeting.

  Commissioner Allison asked if another extension can be granted after March
  2022.

  Mr. Scherer stated that the Municipal Code only allows for one extension to be
  granted.

  It was moved Commissioner Allison and seconded by Commissioner Allred to
  approve the one year extension of the permits. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

9.  SEPTEMBER MEETING

  Mr. Scherer recommended the September meeting be held virtually due to the
  current COVID cases and difficulties with the production of a hybrid meeting.

  The Commissioners supported the decision.

ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 7:51p.m. The next regular meeting of the Planning
  Commission will be held September 8, 2021 at 6:30 p.m.

 Planning Commission Minutes
August 11, 2021
From: tshortreed913@gmail.com [mailto:tshortreed913@gmail.com]
Sent: Wednesday, August 11, 2021 3:53 PM
To: Planning
Subject: OPPOSE - the 9 lot subdivision located at 500 E. Baseline Rd.
Importance: High

The purpose of my email is to oppose the development of approximately 19.44 acre
parcel into a 9 lot subdivision.

Additional expansion continues to encroach on the habitat of the deer, bears, bobcats,
owls, and other numerous animals I’ve seen roaming this open space. Development of
this property requires the destruction of the current natural landscape the removal of 4-
live oak trees. Will the proposed 4-1 replacements be live oaks?

There is an underground spring which fills a rock cave where the animals come to drink.
Development will take that important access to water away. And during the rainy season
the area becomes especially saturated and soggy.

I cannot express strongly enough my opposition to this development. Please leave our
green space and do not move forward with this proposed project.

Respectfully,

Doug & Theresa Shortreed

Sent from Mail for Windows 10
